Standalone HWPX extraction using extract

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"filename\":\"simple.hwpx\",\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/haansofthwpx\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/hwpx/simple.hwpx\"}", "{}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
